messages:
Amy (product): quick sync — ACME Bank wants 7+ years of immutable audit logs + BYOK. They also asked for scoped exportability for legal holds. how feasible is this in next quarter?
Sam (eng-infra): short answer: doable but two big costs: storage + query performance for long-retention buckets. also key management/escrow adds ops work.
Clara (security): we need to validate key escrow options for regulated banks. BYOK + escrow contract + attestation timeline ~6-8 weeks for legal review. @Maya can confirm contract needs.
Maya (legal): correct. escrow + SLA exceptions require DPA addendum + specific language about destroyed vs. retained keys for legal holds. will need customer-signed appendix.
Jordan (sre): operationally, long tail retention means cold-tier exports. Query SLA for audit exports will be different — recommend a tiered SLO: hot (90 days, <2s queries), warm (1yr, <10s), cold (7+yrs, bulk export only).
Amy (product): that aligns with what ACME expects. They insisted exports for e-discovery must be able to produce a zipped evidence package within 48 hours. can we promise that for cold tier?
Sam (eng-infra): 48h for cold-tier is reasonable if we accept offline restore + reindex pipeline. implementation: snapshot -> restore cluster -> run export job. need automation and runbook. estimate: 3 sprints infra work + 1 sprint on runbooks.
Clara (security): also +1 for encrypted-at-rest with customer key during both snapshot and restore. we cannot decrypt in our control plane without escrow key protocol. suggest we define two modes: BYOK-live (customer supplies key), BYOK-escrow (escrowed key accessible only under legal hold).
Amy (product): granular modes make sense. proposal: MVP supports BYOK-live for 90-day hot + warm retention, and BYOK-escrow for cold-tier exports (legal-hold path) — ship in phases. thoughts?
Jordan (sre): phased rollout reduces blast radius. for MVP we should add a feature flag and a canary customer. also add an automatic cost-estimate component when enabling >1yr retention.
Sam (eng-infra): technical sketch: authorship metadata + partitioned audit index. sample retention TTL config (YAML):
```
audit_retention:
  policy_name: acme-bank-longtail
  tiers:
    - name: hot
      ttl_days: 90
      query_sla: 2s
    - name: warm
      ttl_days: 365
      query_sla: 10s
    - name: cold
      ttl_days: 2555  # ~7 years
      access_mode: offline_export_only
```
Sam (eng-infra): export command flow (internal):
```
# start legal hold export
POST /internal/exports?tenant=acme&policy=acme-bank-longtail
# triggers snapshot -> restore -> export job -> s3://exports/acme/holdup-2026-05-01.zip
```
Clara (security): we need audit trail for every step (who requested export, approve chain). tie into SIEM and sign export bundles with HMAC using escrow key.
Maya (legal): approval chain ok, need retention labeling in contract (e.g., "evidence retrieval window 48-72 hours for cold-tier"). small tweak in SLA language helps.
Amy (product): next actions: 1) Sam/Jordan provide a rough implementation plan + cost delta 2) Clara/Maya draft security/contract model for BYOK-escrow 3) I will reach out to ACME for pilot signup. deliverables by EOW?
Sam (eng-infra): can do a 1-pager + rough cost estimate EOW.
Jordan (sre): I'll map the runbook steps and time-to-restore numbers.
Clara (security): I'll propose the escrow flow and key usage constraints.
Maya (legal): I'll draft the contract appendix and ops checklist for sign-off.
deploy-bot: reminder — compliance-feature-flag created: FF-1832-compliance-retention (expires 2026-09-01).
Amy (product): thanks all. tagging thread for prioritization retro — we'll slot this as Q3 pilot if the cost/delivery looks ok. :thumbsup:
